tasks.title: Add the scoped-filter helpers
tasks.description: Add clinicFilter(), organizationFilter() and assertClinicInScope() to TenancyService, built from TenantContext and documented as the required filter for every clinic-scoped query.

tasks.title: Refactor existing tenant filters onto the helper
tasks.description: Refactor OnboardingService.listPendingInvitations and TenancyService.findMembershipInTenant onto the helper and remove the hand-written organization/clinic filters.

tasks.title: Scope the audit write and read paths
tasks.description: Default organizationId/clinicId from TenantContext on audit writes (explicit values still work for non-HTTP callers) and tenant-scope listForEntity.

tasks.title: Document the selector and rejection paths
tasks.description: Verify the global ValidationPipe uses whitelist and forbidNonWhitelisted, and add Swagger descriptions stating that InviteDto.clinicId and SwitchWorkspaceDto.clinicId are selectors re-verified against the caller's memberships.

tasks.title: Keep cross-tenant mutations at 404
tasks.description: Route findMembershipInTenant through the helper and confirm an invitation target outside the caller's organization is treated as not found.

tasks.title: Verify the workspace switch re-verifies membership
tasks.description: Confirm switchWorkspace re-verifies the membership for the selected clinic and refuses a foreign clinic, and refactor any hand-built tenant filter onto the helper.

tasks.title: Carry the clinic scope across refresh
tasks.description: Add a nullable clinicId to RefreshToken with one additive Prisma migration; persist the active clinic on login and switch, re-verify it on refresh and re-issue the same scope, reject an inactive membership, and keep the one-rotation default for legacy rows.

tasks.title: Run lint, typecheck, Prisma generate and governance checks
tasks.description: Run pnpm --filter server lint, tsc --noEmit, prisma generate, sdrive verify strict-tenant-isolation and validate-governance.js; all must pass. Do not run the test suite.

tasks.title: Confirm no raw SQL and no new dependency
tasks.description: Grep the server source for $queryRaw/$executeRaw and confirm no dependency or lockfile change; record the result.
